title: Linkumori rules file
description: A Linkumori rule list: data/linkumori-clearurls.json, a remote rule list, or rules written in the custom rules editor. See docs/filter-syntax.md. Checks that need the whole provider (duplicate ids, targetId pointing at a real raw rule, regexes that compile, capture-group counts) are left to the editor and `node linkumori-cli-tool.js lint-rules`.

$schema.description: Optional link to this schema, for editors.

providers.description: Providers by name. The name is free text; lowercase and descriptive is the convention.

metadata.description: Information about the list. Not used for matching; any extra keys are kept as they are.

provider.description: One provider. It needs domainPatterns or urlPattern, never both.

domainPatterns.description: Which URLs the provider handles, as patterns (docs/filter-syntax.md §2).

urlPattern.description: Which URLs the provider handles, as a regex matched case-insensitively against the full URL.

indexPattern.description: Only with urlPattern: "||host^" hints so the provider is only checked for those hosts. Without it the provider is checked against every URL (lint warning). A string may hold several hints separated by commas or new lines.

rules.description: Query and fragment parameters to remove: a parameter name, a name regex, or a $removeparam filter.

referralMarketing.description: Referral and affiliate parameters to remove, same syntax as rules. Skipped while "Allow referral marketing" is on.

rawRules.description: Regexes run on the full URL; every match is deleted. May be scoped with a pattern and $removeparam options ending in "rawrule=", and "@@…$rawrule=" entries stop them.

exceptions.description: URLs the provider leaves alone: a URL regex, or a "|"-prefixed pattern.

redirections.description: Where to send the request instead: a regex with exactly one capture group, or "||host^$redirect=https://target/". Only used while "Enable Third-Party Redirect Bypass" is on.

fieldRedirections.description: Parameters whose own value is the destination; same entries as rules, but no "@@". Only used while "Enable Third-Party Redirect Bypass" is on.

completeProvider.description: true blocks every request the provider matches (only while "Allow domain blocking" is on).

forceRedirection.description: true: for page loads, redirects navigate the tab instead of redirecting the request.

methods.description: Only handle these HTTP methods. Default: all.

resourceTypes.description: Only handle these request types. Default: the request types chosen in settings.

historyBypassProtection.description: false skips this provider for History API URL changes (pushState/replaceState). Default true.

pattern.description: A URL pattern: "||example.com^", "||example.*^", "||example.com^/path", "|https://…", "…|", "/regex/i", plain text, or "*". A single "|" must be followed by a scheme.

fieldRuleText.description: A parameter name, a name regex, or a $removeparam filter ("@@" in front keeps the parameter).

fieldRedirectText.description: A parameter name, a name regex, or a $removeparam filter; "@@" is not allowed here.

exceptionText.description: A URL regex, or a pattern starting with "|".

redirectText.description: A regex with one capture group, or "||host^$redirect=https://target/".

ruleObject.description: Every key a rule object can have. The list-specific definitions below forbid the keys that do nothing in their list.

matchPattern.description: The same string you would write as a plain entry.

id.description: Stable id used by the rule on/off controls. Unique within the provider.

aliases.description: The rule's previous ids; must not contain its own id.

replacePattern.description: Rewrite instead of remove; §1§, §2§, … are the captured values.

preprocessors.description: Applied to captured values before replacePattern.

exceptions.description: URL regexes (case-insensitive) where this rule does not run. $removeparam filters in rules and referralMarketing use "@@" instead.

flags.description: Regex flags for matchPattern. Default "i"; "gi" in rawRules.

order.description: Run earlier or later than the list normally runs; lowest first. Only in rules, rawRules and referralMarketing, and not on $removeparam filters.

referralMarketing.description: true makes a rule in rules a referral-marketing rule.

historyBypassProtection.description: false skips this rule for History API URL changes.

active.description: false makes the rule off by default.

targetId.description: Only on an "@@…$rawrule=" exception in rawRules: the id or alias of the raw rule it stops.

_linkumoriActivationIds.description: Written by the editor to keep ids stable. Do not edit.

_linkumoriLegacyRuleIds.description: Written by the editor to keep ids stable. Do not edit.

fieldRuleObject.description: A rule object in rules or referralMarketing.

rawRuleObject.description: A rule object in rawRules. An "@@…$rawrule=" exception only stops other raw rules, so it cannot rewrite, reorder or take flags.

inputs.description: "all", or the capture group numbers to transform.
